senelec.title: IPM Medical Coverage Management System (Internal Project – SENELEC)
senelec.description: Development of a web application designed to automate the management of medical coverage requests for SENELEC employees and dependents. The system enables centralization of files, tracking of request status, validation by relevant departments, and generation of statistical reports.

djimasou.title: DJIMASOU GLOBAL TRADING SERVICE
djimasou.description: Development of a website for Djimasou Global Trading Services, a company specializing in the sale of automotive spare parts and accessories. The site presents services, products, contacts, and gives a professional online image to the company.

carim.title: CARIM Imaging — Radiology and Medical Imaging Center
carim.description: Development of a professional showcase website for CARIM Imaging, a medical center based in Grand Yoff (Dakar), specializing in radiology and medical imaging. The site presents the various examinations (MRI, CT scan, Ultrasound, ECG, etc.), practical information, and allows patients to contact the center directly.

senelec2.description: Participated in the development of a web application for real-time data entry, monitoring, and centralization of electrical production data (Instantaneous Power and Hourly Uni Index) from power plants. The system allows automatic calculation of hourly energy, performance visualization by plant and at the Interconnected Network (RI) level, as well as daily data entry and control by statistical agents.

Implementation of real-time data synchronization and validation mechanisms
Development of performance visualization tools and reporting features
Collaboration with cross-functional teams to ensure data accuracy and system reliability

gs7s.role: Full Stack Web Developer / UI-UX Designer (Internship)
gs7s.description: Participated in the complete redesign of the GS7S company website to improve performance, ergonomics, and maintainability. The project involved designing a modern architecture based on React for the frontend and Node.js for the backend, while ensuring database management and optimization. This redesign also aimed to enhance code quality and compliance with best practices through the integration of SonarQube.
tasks: Redesign of the company website using React (frontend) and Node.js (backend)
Implementation of responsive design principles for optimal user experience across devices
Database management and optimization for improved performance
Integration of SonarQube for code quality assurance and best practices compliance
